title: Playboy Magazine July 1972 A Revealing History of Lingerie Vintage Collage
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue. Cover shows toning and soiling with wear and surface creasing along the left edge and spine, and corner wear at the upper and lower left. Please review the photos for exact condition. If centerfold presence matters to you, message me before buying and I will check.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, July 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

The cover feature is "A Revealing History of Lingerie," and the cover itself is a dense collage of period lingerie illustration and advertising art spanning the early decades of the twentieth century - corsets, chemises, stockings and garters drawn in the styles of their day. It is one of the more graphically interesting Playboy covers of the era and stands on its own as a piece of design.

The back cover carries a 1972 Dewar's "White Label" Profiles ad featuring Charles Gordone, the playwright who in 1970 became the first Black playwright to win the Pulitzer Prize for Drama, for "No Place to Be Somebody".

Condition: pre-owned, complete issue with normal signs of age and storage.
